items.details: Use the DS completion record as the final check. Bronze is sufficient for the required medals; gold is an extra challenge. The time-trial goal covers nineteen circuit courses and seven checkpoint events. PSP additions, downloadable Xin missions and online synchronization are outside this original DS checklist. Large collection tasks summarize totals rather than enumerate every location.

details_i18n.en: Use the DS completion record as the final check. Bronze is sufficient for the required medals; gold is an extra challenge. The time-trial goal covers nineteen circuit courses and seven checkpoint events. PSP additions, downloadable Xin missions and online synchronization are outside this original DS checklist. Large collection tasks summarize totals rather than enumerate every location.
details_i18n.pt: Use o registro de conclusão do DS como conferência final. Bronze basta para as medalhas exigidas; ouro é um desafio adicional. As provas contra o relógio abrangem dezenove percursos de circuito e sete eventos de checkpoints. As adições do PSP, as missões de Xin distribuídas por download e a sincronização online ficam fora deste roteiro do DS original. As grandes coleções resumem totais, sem listar cada localização.
